audit_method: Independent script read saved compressed checkpoints; production paired_statistics/analysis/simulation functions were not invoked. Bootstrap recreated with NumPy integer index resampling and a separately implemented variance formula.

uncertainty.strata: four regimes with equal one-quarter weights
uncertainty.se_formula: sqrt(sum(unbiased regime variance of paired differences / regime n)) / 4

scientific_interpretation: The evolved program beats the preselected global constant-two comparator on this final mixture: primary paired error difference is negative and its stratified bootstrap interval excludes zero.

The state-free control has lower mean error than evolved, and the evolved-minus-control interval spans both advantages and disadvantages. These outcomes do not establish value from association with current state; an allocation distribution remains a plausible explanation.
The original corrected baseline has lower mean error than evolved. The positive primary result therefore does not establish overall superiority over the original optimizer.
Global constant two was selected before final seeds. Its poorer final performance is a selection/generalization result; do not replace it post hoc with a different final comparator.
Inference is limited to this fixed radius intervention, declared regime mixture, finite budget and single native evolutionary search. Secondary intervals remain descriptive.
